title: Marguerite and the Postcards
author: Hazel Underhill
blurb: Coral Crane, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
